policy.purpose: Untouched final holdout8; construction validation only
policy.identity_policy: No source, title, author, topical Commons category or series shared with earlier inputs. Administrative licence, maintenance, encoding, camera and distribution-platform categories excluded; every actual excluded overlap retained in identity receipt.
policy.mp4_policy: Fresh native Commons originals retained unmodified. MP4 derivatives are generated from retained originals and explicitly identified with measured GOPs.
policy.network_policy: Serial requests with identifying User-Agent; retain response bytes and SHA-256 before decoding or transformations; no new third-party tools or telemetry.
policy.detector_policy: Nobody runs eidolon detection, grouping, evaluation or scoring on holdout8 before the designated final evaluation. Source-only provenance and disjointness audits are not detector evaluation.
